
```{r}
library(fishualize)
```

A model using <https://github.com/PsyTeachR/introdataviz> where x axis is the joint number, and y axis is the score we use something like the example <https://psyteachr.github.io/introdataviz/advanced-plots.html>

```{r}
#figureM1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = joint, y = score, fill = model)) + split violin things and other layers

```
```{r}
library(moderndive)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
m1_j0 <- read.csv("per_recording_metrics_m1_j0.csv")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
m1_j0<- m1_j0|>
  mutate(joint = "0")|>
  mutate(model = "1")
```

```{r}
ggplot(m1_j0, aes(x = joint, y = rmse, fill = model)) +
  introdataviz::geom_split_violin(alpha = .4, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .2, alpha = .6, fatten = NULL, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", show.legend = F, 
               #position = position_dodge(.175)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Joint", labels = c("0")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "RMSE (ms)")+
                     #breaks = seq(200, 800, 100), 
                    # limits = c(200, 800)) +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Antennarius_commerson")+
  theme_minimal()

```
